description: This file defines the PhpTufValidator class, which validates the installation and configuration of the PHP-TUF plugin within Drupal's Package Manager module. It checks for plugin installation, allowed plugin configuration, and repository TUF support, and reacts to various package management events.

classes.name: PhpTufValidator
classes.description: A final class implementing event-based validation for PHP-TUF plugin installation and configuration within Drupal's Package Manager.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping package manager events to the validate method for event handling.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Handles validation of PHP-TUF configuration during package management events, checking both active and sandbox directories.

methods.name: validateTuf
methods.description: Checks if PHP-TUF plugin is installed, allowed, and enabled for repositories; returns error messages if not properly configured.

methods.name: getRepositoryStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the TUF protection status for configured Composer repositories.
